messages:
maria (marketing): OK team, final draft for the Redwood Optimize launch post is in Drive. We need: publish time, hero headline, final OG image, localized snippets (FR/DE), and lead routing verified.

jorge (growth): Prefer Tue 9:00 PT for global reach. Suggest hero CTA that prioritizes webinar signups + a secondary CTA for the full benchmark PDF.

rishi (product): Tue works. Confirming the two headline metrics we'll cite: ~36% avg cost reduction and 2.3x median latency improvement. Legal asked for a short methodology footnote — I'll paste that into the bottom.

taylor (growthops): Draft routing rules for HubSpot: `if form=launch_blog -> list: optimize_launch; if webinar=true -> tag: webinar_early; if company_size=enterprise -> assign: enterprise_sdr; if interest contains "dedicated" -> add tag: sales_dedicated`. Will attach workflow IDs after staging test.

kate (legal): Quick pass: change any absolutes (e.g., "guaranteed") to softer phrasing ("typically", "in our benchmark"). Provide methodology link text: "Benchmarks run on Redwood eval-suite; representative workloads only. Methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also require consent line on forms.

anika (i18n): I'll translate hero + meta description to FR/DE. Need the final 60-char hero and the 140-char meta for each locale by EOD Thu to finish localization.

sam (design): Uploaded three OG image options (`opt-hero-A.png`, `opt-hero-B.png`, `opt-hero-C.png`) to the assets folder. Prefer B for clarity. Need final alt text and hero quote (50-70 chars).

sasha (customer-success): Heads-up: for pre-launch SDR flows, can we add `question: workload_size` to the form so SDRs can prioritize leads? Also request a PS in the confirmation email linking to self-serve docs.

maria (marketing): Hero headline candidates: 1) "Reduce inference cost by 36% with Redwood Optimize" 2) "2.3x faster median latency in our benchmark" 3) "Optimize inference: faster, cheaper, easier to run" Thoughts?

jorge (growth): Test 1 vs 2 as headline A/B. Use 3 as a short hero subhead for the web copy. We'll measure CTR -> webinar. Add `?utm_experiment=headline_AB` to links.

taylor (growthops): For experiments: map `experiment=headline_AB` and `variant=A/B` in HubSpot. Also configure webhooks to send high-intent leads (company_size>500 && role contains "infra") to `sales_priority:high` via `/api/v1/leads/hook`. I'll test in staging at `https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/optimize` after assets are in.

kate (legal): Also confirm customer quote approvals. Any partner logos must have signed usage. Attach Doc IDs to the post.

rishi (product): Pasting benchmark footnote to the doc now. Also adding a short FAQ snippet addressing quantization and batch sizing.

anika (i18n): For translations: please keep placeholders like `{{utm_params}}` and `{{webinar_time}}` intact so we can localize safely.

sam (design): Alt text suggestion: "line chart showing median latency before and after Redwood Optimize". Hero quote candidate (65 chars): "Optimize inference for faster replies and lower unit costs."

sasha (customer-success): Works for SDR flows. For lifecycle, set webinar registrants to `lifecycle=MQL` and auto-create a support ticket for enterprise trial requests.

maria (marketing): Publish-bot, can you run a checklist and then schedule if all green? Desired publish: 2026-06-15 09:00 PT (2026-06-15T16:00:00Z).

publish-bot: Checklist run -> missing items: localized meta descriptions (FR/DE), final hero quote confirmation, testimonial approval file, and HubSpot experiment IDs. After items uploaded, run `/schedule publish 2026-06-15T16:00Z`.

jorge (growth): I'll own email subject A/B: A) "Reduce inference costs 36% with Redwood Optimize" B) "See 2.3x faster LLM latency in our benchmark". Add `?utm_experiment=email_subj` for tracking.

maria (marketing): Quick legal note included, localization placeholders flagged, design assets vB selected. Final checklist for EOD Thu: 1) hero quote lock 2) FR/DE meta + translations 3) testimonial doc attached 4) HubSpot experiment IDs posted 5) staging routing validation. Please react with :thumbsup: when you complete your item.

kate (legal): :thumbsup: legal attachments added (Doc IDs 11012, 11013).

anika (i18n): :thumbsup: will upload translations by EOD Thu.

sam (design): :thumbsup: OG image `opt-hero-B.png` locked.

taylor (growthops): :thumbsup: will post experiment IDs after staging test (ETA Fri).

sasha (customer-success): :thumbsup: added `workload_size` to form spec.

rishi (product): :thumbsup: FAQ and methodology paragraph added to doc.

maria (marketing): Great  locking to publish Tue 2026-06-15 09:00 PT if all thumbs by EOD Fri. I'll run `/schedule publish 2026-06-15T16:00Z` once publish-bot confirms checklist cleared. Thanks everyone!"
